id: title:Gilbert09:treat read only transaction blips as transient in repartition

review.posthog_relevance: Adds database-level transient error handling for Postgres failover scenarios, preventing unnecessary retries of writes to read-only standbys.
review.reason: Adds psycopg.errors and InternalError to imports; P1.F1.H2 adds a check for psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction wrapped in InternalError; P1.F2.H1 adds InternalError and psycopg.errors to test imports; P1.F2.H2 adds a helper to construct an InternalError with ReadOnlySqlTransaction as __cause__; P1.F2.H3 adds a test case using that helper.
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation and its placement within the broader database connection pool or transaction management layer are not fully described, though the error handling and test support are present.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds psycopg.errors and InternalError to imports; P1.F1.H2 adds a check for psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction wrapped in InternalError; P1.F2.H1 adds InternalError and psycopg.errors to test imports; P1.F2.H2 adds a helper to construct an InternalError with ReadOnlySqlTransaction as __cause__; P1.F2.H3 adds a test case using that helper.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether a database error is transient, including a specific Postgres failover case where a write is routed to a read-only standby, raising psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction, which Django wraps as InternalError. This prevents retrying a write that cannot succeed, avoiding resource exhaustion or corruption. The check is bounded to this specific SQL state, not all InternalE
